data.title: Preview: Dinamo Zagreb vs Bayer Leverkusen - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
## Team News

Dinamo are without centre-back Scott McKenna once again as he recovers from a muscle injury, though Niko Gaselic and Sergi Dominguez should be on hand to start at the heart of the hosts' defence.

Attacking midfielder Robert Mudrazija is also sidelined through injury, so Lukas Kacavenda and Luka Stojkovic could join Josip Misic in the centre of the park. [...] Elsewhere, right-back Guela Doue is dealing with a calf issue, so expect to see Jarell Quansah line up on the right of a four-man defence featuring Edmond Tapsoba, Facundo Medina and Miguel Gutierrez.

Dinamo Zagreb possible starting lineup:

Kotarski; Valincic, Galesic, Dominguez, Goda; Kacavenda, Misic, Stojkovic; Lisica, Beljo, Orsic

Bayer Leverkusen possible starting lineup:

Flekken; Quansah, Tapsoba, Medina, Gutierrez; Andrich, Garcia; Hofmann, Maza, Moreira; Schick [...] As for Leverkusen, they are missing an attacking midfielder of their own, Martin Terrier, due to a hamstring injury, while 17-year-old Kennet Eichhorn is building fitness after his mitochondrial disorder stabilised.

In their absence, Ibrahim Maza looks set to operate in the number 10 role, platformed by Robert Andrich and Aleix Garcia in the side's double pivot.

data.content:

Leverkusen forward Martin Terrier is the only attacker set to miss out, with talisman Patrik Schick ready to feature up front.

- Thursday's showdown will be the first chapter in the sides' head-to-head history.
- It will also mark Leverkusen's first competitive meeting with a Croatian side.
- Dinamo's last encounter with German opposition came in the 2024-25 Champions League league phase, when they lost 9-2 to Bayern Munich and 3-0 to Borussia Dortmund.
- Die Werkself boast the joint-best defensive record in this season's Europa League, having conceded just once in four matches. [...] ## Dinamo Zagreb vs Bayer Leverkusen Prediction

Dinamo's home advantage gives them a major boost this week, having won all but one of their last seven games at Stadion Maksimir.

However, the much stronger Leverkusen have been excellent on the road recently and should only need to avoid complacency to come out on top on Thursday.

Prediction: Dinamo Zagreb 1-2 Bayer Leverkusen

## Dinamo Zagreb vs Bayer Leverkusen Betting Tips

Tip 1 - Result: Bayer Leverkusen to win [...] After claiming four points from their first two Europa League matches, Dinamo Zagreb suffered a setback on matchday three, losing 4-2 at home to NEC Nijmegen. Modri's defensive showing against the Dutch side did not bode well for their trip to the Stadium of Light last time out.

However, Jerko Leko's men remained unfazed and defied the odds against Sunderland, with Luka Stojković and Dion Drena Beljo finding the net in the first half to seal a 2-0 win.

## Team Analysis

Dinamo come into this game on a run of 10 wins, four defeats and a draw from their last 15 matches. Their latest outing was a 3-2 win over Istra 1961, and that result showed the hosts can score goals when they need them. In our preview of Sunderland vs Dinamo Zagreb we backed Sunderland to edge the contest, and the 2-0 result went against us. Dinamo kept their composure and their shape that night, and honestly, we underrated them.
